A portable ritual for daily life, designed to move with you wherever you go. The Refining Care Comb is shaped in our signature peacock emblem and designed for a balanced, effortless grip. Its wide-set teeth gently detangle mid to long hair, helping to smooth and separate without breakage.

Crafted from acetate, each comb reveals a unique pattern—an expression of individuality within a refined, modern form. An object of quiet presence, it transforms a simple gesture into a considered daily ritual.
How_to_Use: Comb gently through dry or damp hair, starting from the ends and working upward.

Description_Customer: The lingering warmth of a light that has just passed—the quiet glow where memory and presence intertwine. Saffron rises like a dry, golden whisper, infusing the air with gentle intensity. In the heart, Guaiac Wood smolders softly—smooth and resinous, its smoky depth unfolding with grace. As the scent settles, warmth and stillness remain, suspended in time. A fragrance of quiet radiance, where depth glows gently beneath the surface—Golden Ember is the afterlight that lingers, long after the flame.
How_to_Use: Apply liberally to pulse points and glide gently onto skin as heat from pulse points activates the perfume – on your wrist, inside your elbow, behind your knee, behind your ears, and at the bottom of your throat. To enhance longevity, moisturize with the Body & Hand Lotion of the same scent before applying the Perfume Oil. Ensure oil is absorbed before coming into contact with delicate fabrics.

Description_Customer:
The PAÑPURI EXTRACT Perfume Oil is a return to the ancient culture of perfumery, innovated for
modern sensorial expression. The highly concentrated fragrance is non-irritating and long-lasting,
derived from precious raw materials and blended with the antioxidant-rich, skin-nourishing Certified
Organic Moringa Seed Oil, a carrier oil found in ancient Ayurvedic wellness traditions. The iconic
multidimensional bottle mimicks a Thai pagoda from ancient Siam, embodying the spiritual journey of
each PAÑPURI EXTRACT Perfume Oil to nurture the mind, body and soul.
